title: Penalties.
bodyText: Any person guilty of committing any of the prohibited acts or omitting any of the required acts of this part shall be guilty of a misdemeanor.
bodyHtml: §486-87  Penalties.  Any person guilty of committing any of the prohibited acts or omitting any of the required acts of this part shall be guilty of a misdemeanor. [L 1988, c 156, pt of §3; am L 1993, c 54, §4]
